The '''''Raider''-class corvette''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] in [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]]. The 150 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to support the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|fighters]] used to engage the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]], chief designer of both the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] and [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], designed the ''Raider''-class corvette to fill a tactical void the Empire had against the Rebel Alliance's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]-oriented strategies. The hardy corvette was armed with dual heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], with some variants carrying concussion missiles. The corvette was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] to complement its use in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] as a patrol ship. There were two sub-classes for this line of vessel, the [[Raider I-class corvette/Legends|''Raider I''-class]] and the [[Raider II-class corvette/Legends|''Raider II''-class corvette]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:RaiderClassCorvetteMissileBarrage-Armada.png|thumb|left|250px|A ''Raider''-class corvette firing a barrage of concussion missiles]]
The ''Raider''-class [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was produced by [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction company [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]]; its design was reminiscent of the dagger-shaped hulls of larger ships used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], such as the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The ship's hull, 150 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, was largely colored [[Color/Legends|gray]], with black blade-like protrusions jutting out from the corvette's sides and bottom. The ''Raider''-class was outfitted with multiple weapon hardpoints, including single [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] batteries, and dual heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]&mdash;the latter weaponry proving more accurate against smaller fighters than turbolasers. Centralized command in the ship contributed to its success, and the ''Raider''-class corvette was built to be durable. Acting in an anti-[[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] role found to be lacking in the Imperial fleet, the ship was designed to counter the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] hit-and-run single-pilot fighter tactics and operated much like the Alliance's own [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]. A [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] allowed the ''Raider''-class to conduct hit-and-run missions against Alliance forces. Like the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers, the ''Raider''-class also came in two sub-types: the [[Raider I-class corvette/Legends|''Raider I''-class]] and the [[Raider II-class corvette/Legends|''Raider II''-class corvettes]].<ref name="Here They Comes">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2015/4/6/here-they-come|text=Here They Come}}</ref><ref name="FFG News" />

==History==
[[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]], daughter of famed engineer [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] and designer of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator'']] and ''Imperial'' Star Destroyers, noted a lack of a vessel to complement the Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]] in the interception of single-pilot starfighters&mdash;a tactic the Alliance to Restore the Republic later used to great effect during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

<div style="float: right">[[File:Raider_I-class_Corvette_2016_SWA_Store_Champtionship_alt_card.png|thumb|250px|A ''Raider I''-class corvette engaged in battle with Rebel forces]]</div>
Lira Wessex designed and presented the ''Raider''-class corvette to fill the tactical breach, and in [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]] production of the corvette by Kuat Drive Yards began. Considered useful in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] by the Empire due to its hyperdrive, the ship offered Imperial officers an opportunity to counter the Alliance's preferred tactics during the Galactic Civil War and saw success in its role. Some time after its construction, a ''Raider''-class corvette was used to test a prototype [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] starfighter in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Though the TIE Advanced would prove to be too costly for mass production, the starfighter's hyperdrive allowed it to operate well with the ''Raider''-class corvette.<ref name="FFG News" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The result was a cross between a Star Destroyer and a single-pilot fighter, something fast and aggressive.|Fantasy Flight Games development team|<ref name="FFG News" />}}
[[File:Raider_corvette_prelim_designs.png|thumb|left|250px|Preliminary designs by Ben Zweifel for what would become the ''Raider''-class corvette]]
The ''Raider''-class corvette was created by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as a additional component of their ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game]]''. The ship was first announced on the company's website on [[December 19]], [[2014]], in a news piece detailing a [[Imperial Raider Expansion Pack (Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game)|then-upcoming expansion pack]] to the [[Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game Core Set|base game]]. Intending to create a similar starship to the Rebellion's [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] corvette, which acts in-game in an anti-starfighter role, the game's development team, including [[Andrew Navaro]], [[Frank Brooks]], and [[Steve Kimball]], first looked to existing material in the [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity. The Imperial [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]] was considered for the role, but the ship's 250 meter length was considered too unwieldy for game play. Failing to find a suitable candidate, the development team worked with [[Lucasfilm]] to create a new ship, which would eventually become the ''Raider''-class corvette.<ref name="FFG News" /> The look of the ''Raider''-class corvette was designed and created by artist [[Ben Zweifel]].<ref>{{Twitter|pixelgarbage|status/546007375619297281|[[Ben Zweifel]]|quote=Box art for the new Imperial Raider that I designed! It was just announced.|archivefile=File:Ben Zweifel Raider Creator.png}}</ref>
